fields.gemini:
1) Legal, Technical and RCU to be positive.
2) Applicant’s Dual Signature affidavit to be provided.
3) Repayment to be taken from applicant’s savings account with ICICI Bank vide no.193701518037
4) Applicant Active Flexi Personal Loan with Bajaj Finance in Nov 2019 Rs.8.50 Lakhs loan closer proof to be provided.
5) Current Residence valid rental agreement to be provided,
6) Applicant February month pending salary credited bank statement to be provided
7) Co Applicant Mrs.Vijayalakshmi N Clear Pan card copy to be provided
8) Disbursement towards Plot will be 50% of the loan amount or 60% of the Plot Cost, whichever is less.
9) Affidavit provided saying that construction will commence within 6 months and will be completed within 18 months of the date of date of first disbursement.
10) If construction not started within 6 months of 1st disbursement then MHFCL will hike ROI by 4% on disbursed amount & cancel pending sanction amount.Tenor will also be reduced to max tenor of 10 years
